intro.text: Holly Brainard is a lifelong Three Village resident and Three Village schools graduate who came to real estate from a tech career at IBM. Michael O'Dwyer grew up in St. James and has spent more than 40 years in North Shore real estate, carrying on the family business his mother Virginia O'Dwyer started. Both are active members of the Three Village Historical Society, and both have a soft spot for old houses.
intro.quote: The O'Dwyer-Brainard team made selling our parents home one of the easiest things we've ever done!
